authorization.authorization_context: Competence run 002 — REPLACEMENT for run 001, which the in-job stage-1 gate stopped BEFORE any training (the fail-and-stop rule, working as designed). The gate's two defects are fixed and test-locked (129 graph tests): the gate now checks the REGISTERED quantity — distinguishable module INPUTS (same-token rewiring > 10x the reorder input baseline) — while module output differences are REPORTED, not gated; and a stage-1 failure returns a complete result with the preserved stage-1 measurements and outcome STAGE1_CHECK_FAILED, never a bare exception. Everything else is UNCHANGED from COMPETENCE_RUN_001.md: ONE job runs the whole fixed sequence, single arm (cas framing), no two-arm comparison. STAGE 1: relationship input check + forward/backward sanity (zero optimizer steps). STAGE 2: bounded training on the familiar train+practice whole-part examples — 64 optimizer steps / 600 s, lr 0.003, learning curve every 8 steps, digest containment (operation:^6 only). STAGE 3 (only if mean after-loss < mean before-loss - 0.02): sealed validation/test evaluation with predictions before answers, plus familiar-example accuracy, reported separately. The deliverable is exactly one of LEARNED_AND_TRANSFERRED (criterion met AND sealed >= 6/12), LEARNED_NO_TRANSFER (criterion met, sealed < 6/12), DID_NOT_FIT (criterion not met), or STAGE1_CHECK_FAILED (preserved numbers) — computed by a deterministic rule. No silent mid-run patches, no unlimited retries, no spending beyond this single job; the training pilot beyond this run stays pending.
